name: derrcs-root
description: Distributed Emergency Response and Resource Coordination System (DERRCS) Root

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm run install-registry && npm run install-auth && npm run install-resource && npm run install-incident && npm run install-dispatch && npm run install-broker && npm run install-frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev-registry" "npm run dev-auth" "npm run dev-resource" "npm run dev-incident" "npm run dev-dispatch" "npm run dev-broker" "npm run dev-frontend"
